dimension_justifications.soundness: The source, bundled assets, and bibliography rebuild byte-identically to the supplied PDF, but central empirical results cannot be independently checked from this snapshot: code, result artifacts, configurations, and frozen numerical verifiers are absent. The records explicitly distinguish verifier replay from a training/evaluation replay, so reported PASS results are not independently auditable here.
dimension_justifications.presentation: The manuscript clearly labels normal/CLT findings as asymptotic, constrains the width surrogate, states limitations, and provides an AI-use statement. However, many evidence references point to unavailable artifacts, and inconsistent historical hashes in provenance records make it harder to determine which source/PDF generation they describe.
dimension_justifications.contribution: The paper contains a self-contained presentation of its theoretical construction and unusually explicit claim boundaries. Its empirical contribution remains only reported rather than reproducibly supported by the submitted artifact bundle, limiting confidence in headline certificate frontier and allocation findings.

paper_summary: The paper proposes finite-sample certificate-gated selection among fixed models under subgroup-mixture turnover, evaluates exact paired and unpaired certificates on four public classification carriers, and studies budget-allocation diagnostics while excluding normal/CLT results from finite-sample support and excluding the width surrogate from actual-regret-UCB optimization claims.
strongest_verified_contribution: The frozen source package is sufficient to reproduce the supplied 14-page PDF exactly: an isolated LaTeX/BibTeX build produced SHA-256 9147fdbbc1aea99cb9031b5dfd72dd625ddcead6aa12c5636a00c5bd1276274d, matching the manifest and audit record. The manuscript also clearly separates exact, asymptotic, surrogate, and planned-experiment claims.
strengths: All files listed by MANIFEST.json matched their listed SHA-256 values.
The supplied source, style files, bibliography, and figure form a self-contained deterministic manuscript build matching the archived PDF byte-for-byte.
PDF metadata has an empty Author field and the manuscript declares Anonymous; no author-identifying source material was found.
The manuscript labels normal/CLT as asymptotic only and repeatedly narrows the width-surrogate claim.
Citation keys compile without undefined warnings, and the citation lock records support checks for active citations.
The AI-use statement is explicit and appropriately scoped.
questions: Will the authors archive the immutable result files, verifier scripts, configurations, commands, logs, and environment specification needed to rederive every headline table and figure?
Can the authors provide a documented canonical algorithm for deriving snapshot_sha256 from the manifest/file set?

Why do the build record and repository inventory report the older 258def/fbcff hashes as current frozen-paper objects while the supplied manifest and isolated rebuild establish 420470/9147fd for revision_01_4?

issues.location: manuscript headline numeric claims; experiment registry E03--E08; repository inventory; build record
issues.observed_evidence: The manuscript reports headline rates and coverage, including 0.260/0.097/0.503 and 0 violations over 4200 cells. The registry marks associated runs as executed snapshot artifacts not replayed. The bundle contains neither results, code, nor remote_snapshot, despite evidence inventory and manuscript references naming such paths. build_record.json reports read-only verifier outcomes but supplies neither scripts nor input artifacts and says this is not a training/evaluation replay.
issues.why_it_matters: Central empirical numbers are not independently traceable to a bundled executable or immutable result object. A statement that a verifier passed cannot substitute for the verifier, inputs, and outputs; artifact-level checks must not be represented as full experimental replay.
issues.required_fix: Release a self-contained empirical artifact package or stable immutable archive containing exact result files, verifier scripts, code/configuration revisions, commands, seeds, split definitions/hashes, environment, and logs. Add a claim-to-command-to-output table and label numerical-verifier replay separately from full experiment replay.
issues.verification_test: In a clean environment, run documented artifact verifiers against bundled immutable results and reproduce every cited headline number; then execute at least one documented end-to-end rerun or retain the no-full-replay boundary. Confirm all cited paths resolve.
issues.evidence_needed: Content-addressed result artifacts, code/configuration hashes, verifier outputs, environment lock, seed/split metadata, and command logs.

issues.observed_evidence: The manifest and independent rebuild identify revision_01_4 as source 420470 and PDF 9147fd. In contrast, build_record local_read_only_checks and repository_inventory describe 258def/fbcff as identical current frozen paper objects. The inventory also says the snapshot contains approximately 30 Python files and 39 result/log files, but those objects are not present. MANIFEST gives a root snapshot SHA-256 without specifying a canonical derivation algorithm.
issues.why_it_matters: Stale or ambiguously scoped provenance assertions prevent a reviewer from determining which historical assertions apply and from recomputing the asserted root snapshot identity, even though individual listed-file hashes verify.
issues.required_fix: Replace or clearly label superseded historical hash assertions; make the inventory describe only the delivered artifact or provide the referenced archive. Specify a canonical snapshot-hash procedure with path ordering, included files, byte encoding, and one-command verifier.
issues.verification_test: A fresh reviewer can reproduce the root snapshot hash, verify every manifest entry, and find every object counted by the inventory at the stated path or immutable archive URI.
issues.evidence_needed: Corrected provenance inventory, canonical root-hash specification/verifier, and immutable locations for referenced historical objects.

ethics_concerns: No direct ethics violation is established. The paper appropriately states that natural time/geographic validation and operational fallback costs remain unmeasured.
llm_usage_disclosure: This review was produced by an isolated AI subagent for internal pre-submission quality control.
evidence_that_would_raise_score: A self-contained or immutable empirical artifact release that rederives all headline tables, figures, and coverage/commit-rate values from included inputs.
A documented full-replay protocol with configurations, split hashes, seeds, environment lock, and at least one successful clean rerun, distinct from artifact verifier checks.
A consistent, canonically reproducible manifest/root-hash scheme and corrected provenance inventory.
evidence_that_would_lower_score: Any released artifact or verifier failing to reproduce 0.260/0.097/0.503, 1.000 reported coverage, or 4200-cell claims.
Evidence that calibration/test isolation, seeds, splits, or predeclared mixture grids differ from the manuscript.
A mismatch between archived source/PDF and artifacts claimed to underlie numerical tables.
review_limitations: This audit was restricted to the frozen submission and bundled rubric/schema; no external repo, web, raw dataset, or full environment was inspected.
The paired-certificate proof was not formally proof-checked; this review assesses reproducibility/provenance.
